speaker: Doctor
text: Can you tell me exactly what you or your parents see happening when you wake up frightened? Also, do you have any history of bedwetting or unusual leg movements?

speaker: Patient
text: 8-year-old female. The patient has been experiencing difficulty sleeping for the past 2 months, with episodes of waking up frightened occurring one to two times per week. During these episodes, she yells and cries but does not seem confused after waking and can be consoled by her parents. The following day, she appears more tired than usual.

speaker: Doctor
text: Has she ever experienced sudden, involuntary jerking movements of her legs while asleep, often accompanied by a sensation of falling? REQUEST TEST: Overnight Video Polysomnography

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the sleep study was normal and we haven't found a neurological cause yet, does she snore loudly or stop breathing briefly during her sleep? Also, have you noticed any daytime sleepiness or attention difficulties at school?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Difficulty sleeping with episodes of waking up frightened. I also have Yelling and crying during sleep episodes, Temporary post-episode tiredness, Recollection of bad dreams, Bedtime procrastination.
